title: Creating a Multimodal Dataset of Images and Text to Study Abusive Language
reasoning: The paper's methodology and data collection process are fundamentally shaped by ethical considerations, particularly because the participants are underage students. Section 8, "Discussion", is extensively devoted to the ethical design of the study, including the simulated setting to protect minors, the process of obtaining consent, and the framing of the annotation task within a broader educational goal of understanding cyberbullying dynamics (the roles of bully and victim). This deep integration of ethical concerns into the research design goes beyond a standard, brief 'Ethical Considerations' section.
